changelog: v1.3.7 Ultra-Low Latency Release: 1) Hardware WIFI_MODE_FULL_LOW_LATENCY lock (API 29+) in foreground service to eliminate Wi-Fi power-save jitter. 2) Client-side jitterBufferTarget = 0 & playoutDelayHint = 0 for zero-latency frame presentation. 3) Offline direct mobile hotspot WebRTC zero-STUN engine.
